info.title: CoFund API
info.description: The generated contract for CoFund API v1. Business operations require a verified user session and active organisation/role context.

cookieAuth.name: cofund-session
cookieAuth.description: First-party Fortify web session. State-changing requests also require CSRF protection.

OrganisationContext.name: X-Organisation-ID
OrganisationContext.description: Verified organisation public UUID. When omitted, the active session context is used.

BranchContext.name: X-Branch-ID
BranchContext.description: Optional verified branch public UUID. Valid only with X-Organisation-ID.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required by documented retry-sensitive financial commands.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated user or selected context is not authorized.

RateLimited.description: The API rate limit was exceeded.
